name: Epic Envenomed Blade
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Envenomed Blade

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Poison Blast
effects.tooltip: Poison Blast 4 : This weapon drips with vile poison, dealing 4d6 Poison damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Poison damage on a critical hit.

effects.name: Improved Paralyzing
effects.tooltip: Improved Paralyzing : Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a DC 28 Will save or be paralyzed. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the paralysis lasts for 1 minute.

effects.name: Armor-Piercing
effects.tooltip: Armor-Piercing 15% : Passive: +15% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

effects.name: Deadly Spider Venom
effects.tooltip: Deadly Spider Venom : This item is steeped in deadly spider venom. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will inflict the target with a poison that deals 10d6 poison damage every 2 seconds for 6 seconds. When the poison wears off, it also deals 3d6 Constitution damage to the target. A successful Fortitude save (DC 34) negates the Constitution damage.

effects.name: Enervation
effects.tooltip: Enervation : This weapon stores a menacing, ravenous power deep within. When this weapon is used, this power occasionally comes to the surface, draining the life force of the enemy and giving negative levels .

flavor_text: A small blade wielded by the drow assassins of Faerun's Underdark, steeped in a powerful poison that causes persistent damage to its targets. It is also a thin and sharp enough weapon to bypass the defenses of many targets and deliver critical blows.
